Requirements
Settle the HMAC question with Talles first, and only then decide the shape here.
Acceptance Criteria
The endpoint refuses traffic beyond a stated bound rather than queueing it indefinitely.
A refusal uses the existing error contract and does not introduce a new HTTP status.
Withdrawal-path latency under sustained status traffic is stated, not assumed.
Whether the limit is in-app or at the edge is recorded with its reasoning.
